question: A 26-year-old woman presents to the obstetrics ward to deliver her baby. The obstetrician establishes a pudendal nerve block via intravaginal injection of lidocaine near the tip of the ischial spine. From which of the following nerve roots does the pudendal nerve originate?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Pudendal nerve" -> "Originates from S2-S4 nerve roots" -> 95% CHAIN: "Pudendal nerve block" -> "Involves injection near the tip of the ischial spine" -> "Originates from S2-S4 nerve roots" -> 95%
analysis: The pudendal nerve originates from the S2-S4 nerve roots.
